overview:
This 6 day Rwanda celebration safari is for groups marking a special moment together, such as a milestone birthday, an anniversary, a reunion or a wedding party. You see the Big Five in Akagera, trek to mountain gorillas and golden monkeys in Volcanoes National Park, and stay in some of Rwanda's finest lodges.

Why choose a 6 day Rwanda celebration safari?

Few experiences mark a milestone like sitting with a gorilla family. This trip pairs that hour with two nights at Magashi Camp in Akagera, where boat cruises and game drives offer time to relax together, and two nights at Bisate Lodge near the volcanoes.

We can arrange a celebration dinner, a cake, decorations or a surprise for the guest of honour at either lodge.

What does the celebration itinerary include?

One night in Kigali, two at Magashi Camp in Akagera and two at Bisate Lodge in Volcanoes National Park. The last day includes golden monkey trekking before the drive back to Kigali for your flights.

Can guests who don't want to trek still come?

Yes. Guests under 15 or who prefer not to trek can visit the Ellen DeGeneres Campus of the Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund, the Gorilla Guardians Village or a nature walk while the others trek.

Read our guides to gorilla trekking in Rwanda and golden monkey trekking.

Who is the 6 day rwanda celebration safari best for?

The 6 day rwanda celebration safari is best for milestone birthdays, anniversaries, reunions, retirements and wedding parties. Tell us the occasion and we will plan the special moments with the lodges, so the 6 day rwanda celebration safari runs at the right pace for your group.

How do group bookings work?

For every six paying travellers, the seventh place is free. Each traveller can pay separately, and people can arrive on different flights. A deposit of 30 to 40% holds the booking and the balance is due 2 to 4 weeks before travel. Full payment and cancellation rules are in our terms and conditions.

How many guests can join the 6 day Rwanda celebration safari?

Luxury camps in Rwanda are small, so we plan rooms early and can split a large group between two lodges of the same standard. Gorilla families take up to 8 visitors each, so bigger groups trek to different families at the same time.

How do I get a group quote?

Price on request. Group prices depend on your dates, the number of travellers and the rooms you need, so we quote every group personally. WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com, use our group safari inquiry form or request a tailor-made quote. Read more about special occasion safaris.

faq.q: What is the minimum age for gorilla trekking?

faq.q: When is the best time for a Rwanda celebration safari?
faq.a: June to September and December to February are the driest months for trekking. Gorillas can be seen all year, and the green seasons are quieter. Tell us your dates and group size and we will confirm this in the quote for your 6 day rwanda celebration safari.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.content: Your 6 day rwanda celebration safari begins today. Meet your guide at Kigali International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Dinner and overnight at Kigali Marriott Hotel or similar.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Kigali to Akagera National Park
itinerary.content: Drive east to Akagera National Park for game drives and a boat cruise on Lake Rwanyakazinga. Dinner and overnight at Magashi Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Akagera safari day
itinerary.content: A full day of game drives and boat cruises in search of lions, rhinos, elephants and buffalo, with time to relax at camp. Dinner and overnight at Magashi Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Akagera to Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.content: Drive about 5 hours to Volcanoes National Park, then visit the Ellen DeGeneres Campus of the Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund. Dinner and overnight at Bisate Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Mountain gorilla trekking and Gorilla Guardians Village
itinerary.content: Trek with rangers to a mountain gorilla family and spend one hour with them. In the afternoon, visit the Gorilla Guardians Village for traditional dances. Dinner and overnight at Bisate Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Golden monkey trekking and departure
itinerary.content: Trek to find golden monkeys, then drive back to Kigali International Airport for your flights. This is the end of your 6 day rwanda celebration safari.
